purpose: Mentions that must never appear in the Mentions Library or the Overview again, whatever the collector finds. Permanent: nothing removes an entry except the owner.
matching: A found mention is excluded if its canonical link (tmi_keys.canonical_url) or its collector id equals one of an entry's urls / collector_ids. A collector id is a fingerprint of the collector's exact title and source text, so a re-found record with identical text is caught; a differently worded title is never matched (two entries are duplicate copies of articles the library keeps under another link, and those kept records must not be excluded). Separately, a found mention whose canonical link or title+source (tmi_keys.title_key) equals a curated record is a duplicate of it and is not added.

kinds.removed: taken out by hand; must never return
kinds.duplicate_copy_removed: the redundant copy of an article that stays in the library under kept_as
